description: This file is a test suite for the ConnectionManager class within the 'ai.openclaw.app.node' package. It contains unit tests using Robolectric and JUnit to verify TLS parameter resolution, gateway host detection, and node connection options for an Android application related to OpenClaw project.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerTest
classes.description: Test suite for ConnectionManager, including tests for TLS parameter resolution, host classification, and connection options based on device capabilities and network environment.

methods.name: newManager
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate a ConnectionManager with customizable device capabilities and permissions, used in multiple tests.
